## Runtime static faces (2026-09-09)

Use the same v1.3.9 release archive, with the static OTF files below. The original variable font remains as source history. Runtime UI explicitly selects the Regular and SemiBold TextCore SDF assets; it does not synthesize bold strokes from the variable font.

- `public/static/Pretendard-Regular.otf`: SHA-256 `3ffbacde6ab8411f1d2db54bb9b1f0b3ee2a738932033722cf0388c06aed1c93`
- `public/static/Pretendard-SemiBold.otf`: SHA-256 `c89bc43027dc7cde5726e96223376f8eec09302b2fc1f8147fd5b57cfc376118`

The SDF atlases are generated by `UiTypographySetup` at 64px sampling with 6px padding, 2048px dynamic atlases and prewarmed UI Hangul. Atlas derivatives remain under ThirdParty with this license.
